title: feat: make the sign-in bounce rate measurable
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Answers "what share of people who reach the sign-in page never click through" — without any browser identifier.

**The problem:** `pct_started` divided starts by views, but the two counted different populations. `sign_in_started` fires for sign-ins begun anywhere (pollinations.ai, gen redirects, app OAuth entry); `sign_in_viewed` only sees the enter dashboard. Production showed 38 starts against 29 views, so the ratio read 7500%.

**The fix:**
- `sign_in_started` records the page it came from, read from the `Referer` and accepted only if it matches a known route (reuses `productPageViewSchema.shape.page.options` — one source of truth). Anything else stays `''` and falls out of the ratio.
- `pct_started` divides by views of those same pages. `pct_completed` keeps the unfiltered `sign_in_started_anywhere`, which matches `sign_in_completed`. Each ratio now uses a matched pair.
- `signup_completed` fires from a `user.create` database hook, so new vs returning separates in real time rather than joining the `d1_user` snapshot (daily, so up to 24h stale).

The originating page is a property of the request, not of the person — no cookie, no id, no privacy-policy change.

Tinybird `--check` against staging: 1 modified endpoint, no deletions, no data copied.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
- Also records the page a `checkout_started` came from, so `/_dashboard/pollen` and `/top-up` get separate conversion rates instead of one undifferentiated count.

gist.headline: Funnels find their footing
gist.blurb: The sign-in garden now counts bees from the same flower patch at both ends. Checkout paths also keep their own little trails, without following anyone home.
gist.summary: Auth analytics now records validated referring pages for sign-in and checkout starts, computes sign-in conversion from matched page-view populations, and emits signup completion directly from the user.create hook.
gist.impact: The team can measure sign-in bounce rates and separate /_dashboard/pollen from /top-up checkout conversion accurately without cookies or browser identifiers.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny surveyor tracing two clearly matched garden paths from sign-in-page flowers to a cozy door, while a retro terminal shows tidy conversion counters. Separate pollen trails lead from /_dashboard/pollen and /top-up to distinct checkout baskets, representing page-level attribution without tracking individual bees.
